c74object.name: evi_biquads_coeffs
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_biquads_coeffs.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_biquads_coeffs.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
About this File:
40 different coefficient calculators for Biquad filter types. All Cutoffs in Hz, all Gains are linear, all Qs are Q or S. All returns are a0, a1, a2, b1, b2 coefficients.

Return 2: a1, a1 coefficient
Return 3: a2, a2 coefficient
Return 4: b1, b1 coefficient
Return 5: b2, b2 coefficient
